snippet.title: The Infernalist - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The official reveal trailer for The Infernalist, a compelling point-and-click adventure video game where you dive into a rich narrative filled with exploration, puzzles, and turn-based combat, all set against the backdrop of a visually stunning environment.

Embark on a mysterious journey through a fractured realm where eras clash and realities intertwine. The Infernalist tests the boundaries between realities combining fantasy and science fiction elements in a unique and captivating way. The Infernalist is coming soon to Steam Early Access.

🔥 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824970/
📌 Stay tuned for the upcoming demo and Chapter 1 EA launch.
